s0202.literal: On jiyou day Fujian Province reported that bandits were swarming within its jurisdiction and requested additional garrison troops; Jiang-Huai Province was ordered to dispatch one ten-thousand-household army unit.
s0202.idiomatic: On jiyou day Fujian Province reported that bandits were swarming within its jurisdiction and requested additional garrison troops; Jiang-Huai Province was ordered to dispatch one ten-thousand-household army unit.

s0203.literal: Five hundred tammaq troops of the Mongol Chief Ten-thousand-household Office were dispatched to garrison Ezhou.
s0203.idiomatic: Five hundred tammaq troops of the Mongol Chief Ten-thousand-household Office were dispatched to garrison Ezhou.

s0204.literal: On xinhai day the Temple of the Broad Virtue King in the Eastern Sea was repaired.
s0204.idiomatic: On xinhai day the Temple of the Broad Virtue King in the Eastern Sea was repaired.

s0205.literal: On bingchen day an amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
s0205.idiomatic: On bingchen day an amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

s0206.literal: On dingmao day the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat was ordered to audit the tax and rent paid by Jiangnan entertainers under the Music Office, and four inspection offices were established north of Suqian.
s0206.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat was ordered to audit the tax and rent paid by Jiangnan entertainers under the Music Office, and four inspection offices were established north of Suqian.

s0207.literal: Dismissed overland transport laborers were made soldiers to escort supplies on the Hui Tong canal, and conscripting civilians to tow boats was forbidden.
s0207.idiomatic: Dismissed overland transport laborers were made soldiers to escort supplies on the Hui Tong canal, and conscripting civilians to tow boats was forbidden.

s0208.literal: Winter, tenth month, renshen day: the imperial grandson Gammala was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang, given a gold seal, and sent to command Yunnan.
s0208.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, renshen day: the imperial grandson Gammala was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang, given a gold seal, and sent to command Yunnan.

s0209.literal: On guiyou day offerings were made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0209.idiomatic: On guiyou day offerings were made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0210.literal: On jiaxu day the Hui Tong-Wen-Si canal-route intendant office was established, rank 4b.
s0210.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the Hui Tong-Wen-Si canal-route intendant office was established at rank 4b.

s0211.literal: On dingchou day ministry secretariat officials said: "In Jiangyin, Ningguo, and other circuits great floods occurred; 458,478 households were displaced.
s0211.idiomatic: On dingchou day ministry secretariat officials said, "In Jiangyin, Ningguo, and other circuits great floods occurred; 458,478 households were displaced.

s0212.literal: " The Emperor said: "Why wait to report this upward? Relief should be dispatched at once!
s0212.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Why wait to report this upward? Relief should be dispatched at once!"

s0213.literal: " In all 582,889 shi of grain was issued.
s0213.idiomatic: In all 582,889 shi of grain was issued.

s0214.literal: On jimao day one additional deputy prefect and one additional magistrate were added to the Shangdu garrison command.
s0214.idiomatic: On jimao day one additional deputy prefect and one additional magistrate were added to the Shangdu garrison command.

s0215.literal: At Gansu branch secretariat's request, 1,300 civilians within its jurisdiction were drafted as soldiers to garrison the region.
s0215.idiomatic: At Gansu branch secretariat's request, 1,300 civilians within its jurisdiction were drafted as soldiers to garrison the region.

s0216.literal: On xinsi day Venus transgressed Dou.
s0216.idiomatic: On xinsi day Venus transgressed Dou.

s0217.literal: The Balghasi under Zhishen's command suffered famine; Ningxia Circuit was ordered to provide 3,000 shi of rice for relief.
s0217.idiomatic: The Balghasi under Zhishen's command suffered famine; Ningxia Circuit was ordered to provide 3,000 shi of rice for relief.

s0218.literal: Wine-brewing was forbidden in Datong Circuit.
s0218.idiomatic: Wine-brewing was forbidden in Datong Circuit.

s0219.literal: On yiyou day Mondar came from the Branch Censorate to have an audience.
s0219.idiomatic: On yiyou day Mondar came from the branch censorate to have an audience.

s0220.literal: Liangdong Liang Gongchao, Wuqudong Wu Tangnuan, and twenty cave communities in all submitted with more than 2,000 households.
s0220.idiomatic: Liangdong Liang Gongchao, Wuqudong Wu Tangnuan, and twenty cave communities in all submitted with more than 2,000 households.

s0221.literal: On dinghai day 100,000 bolts of silk cloth were granted to the northern frontier.
s0221.idiomatic: On dinghai day 100,000 bolts of silk cloth were granted to the northern frontier.

s0222.literal: On jichou day new temple ascent hymns and palace suspended music were made for the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0222.idiomatic: On jichou day new temple ascent hymns and palace suspended music were made for the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0223.literal: Because in the past palace falconers annually took cormorants at Chengdu and harassed the people, this was abolished.
s0223.idiomatic: Because in the past palace falconers annually took cormorants at Chengdu and harassed the people, this was abolished.

s0224.literal: Eleventh month, xinchou day: great flood at Hongji garrison in the Guangji office; 13,141 shi of rent was remitted.
s0224.idiomatic: Eleventh month, xinchou day: great flood at Hongji garrison in the Guangji office; 13,141 shi of rent was remitted.

s0225.literal: Frost in Xing and Song prefectures killed the grain crop; their rent was remitted.
s0225.idiomatic: Frost in Xing and Song prefectures killed the grain crop; their rent was remitted.

s0226.literal: Famine at Longxing's Kuyanliao and other relay stations; 7,000 ingots of notes were issued for relief.
s0226.idiomatic: Famine at Longxing's Kuyanliao and other relay stations; 7,000 ingots of notes were issued for relief.

s0227.literal: On dingwei day, because many Mongols in Datong Circuit fraudulently claimed others' names to draw rations, ten chiliarch and centurion posts were established under a darughachi for oversight; those who registered wealthy households as poor had half their household property registered.
s0227.idiomatic: On dingwei day, because many Mongols in Datong Circuit fraudulently claimed others' names to draw rations, ten chiliarch and centurion posts were established under a darughachi for oversight; those who registered wealthy households as poor had half their household property registered.

s0228.literal: On wushen day the moon transgressed Saturn.
s0228.idiomatic: On wushen day the moon transgressed Saturn.

s0229.literal: Sangge said: "Previously, by imperial edict, officials inside and outside who received appointments but did not report, and replacement officials who stayed five years without reporting for reassignment, were dismissed and not reappointed.
s0229.idiomatic: Sangge said, "Previously, by imperial edict, officials inside and outside who received appointments but did not report, and replacement officials who stayed five years without reporting for reassignment, were dismissed and not reappointed.

s0230.literal: I say that if there is no grave cause, they should not be abandoned forever.
s0230.idiomatic: I say that if there is no grave cause, they should not be abandoned forever.

s0231.literal: " The Emperor again approved his request.
s0231.idiomatic: The Emperor again approved his request.

s0232.literal: Jiang-Huai branch secretariat pingzhang Bulaghandai said: "Bandits in Fujian have been pacified; only in Zhedong circuit the land is extremely rugged and border-like, a bandits' nest.
s0232.idiomatic: Jiang-Huai branch secretariat pingzhang Bulaghandai said, "Bandits in Fujian have been pacified; only in Zhedong circuit the land is extremely rugged and border-like, a bandits' nest.

s0233.literal: Three ten-thousand-household units are being returned: one army under Qelatai to garrison coastal Ming and Tai; one under Yekele to garrison Wen and Chu; one under Jaqutai to garrison Shaoxing and Wu.
s0233.idiomatic: Three ten-thousand-household units are being returned: one army under Qelatai to garrison coastal Ming and Tai; one under Yekele to garrison Wen and Chu; one under Jaqutai to garrison Shaoxing and Wu.

s0234.literal: In Ningguo and Hui together, native troops were first used, but later all colluded with bandits; now Han armies from Gaoyou and Tai two ten-thousand-household units are exchanged to garrison there.
s0234.idiomatic: In Ningguo and Hui together, native troops were first used, but later all colluded with bandits; now Han armies from Gaoyou and Tai two ten-thousand-household units are exchanged to garrison there.

s0235.literal: Yangzhou, Jiankang, and Zhenjiang—three cities straddling the great river with dense populations—each received a seven-ten-thousand-household garrison office.
s0235.idiomatic: Yangzhou, Jiankang, and Zhenjiang—three cities straddling the great river with dense populations—each received a seven-ten-thousand-household garrison office.

s0236.literal: Where Hangzhou branch secretariat offices and treasuries are located, a four-ten-thousand-household garrison office was established.
s0236.idiomatic: Where Hangzhou branch secretariat offices and treasuries are located, a four-ten-thousand-household garrison office was established.

s0237.literal: For naval warfare, formerly only ten stations existed; now twenty-two critical coastal and riverside posts were selected, with troops divided for drill and to watch for bandits.
s0237.idiomatic: For naval warfare, formerly only ten stations existed; now 22 critical coastal and riverside posts were selected, with troops divided for drill and to watch for bandits.

s0238.literal: Qiantang controls the sea mouth; formerly twenty war junks were stationed, so sea bandits sometimes appeared, seized boats, and killed people; now one hundred war junks and twenty sea-going vessels were added, so bandits dare not act.
s0238.idiomatic: Qiantang controls the sea mouth; formerly 20 war junks were stationed, so sea bandits sometimes appeared, seized boats, and killed people; now 100 war junks and 20 sea-going vessels were added, so bandits dare not act.

s0240.literal: On gengxu day collecting turquoise from Bidian in Yunnan's Huichuan Circuit was abolished.
s0240.idiomatic: On gengxu day collecting turquoise from Bidian in Yunnan's Huichuan Circuit was abolished.

s0241.literal: On jiayin day wine-brewing was forbidden at Shangdu.
s0241.idiomatic: On jiayin day wine-brewing was forbidden at Shangdu.

s0242.literal: On yimao day 330 guich households lacked food; grain was issued for relief.
s0242.idiomatic: On yimao day 330 guich households lacked food; grain was issued for relief.

s0243.literal: On jiwei day wine-brewing was forbidden in the region behind the mountains.
s0243.idiomatic: On jiwei day wine-brewing was forbidden in the region behind the mountains.

s0244.literal: On gengshen day the troops under Bayan were each granted 13,400 bolts of silk cloth and 3,400 jin of cotton.
s0244.idiomatic: On gengshen day the troops under Bayan were each granted 13,400 bolts of silk cloth and 3,400 jin of cotton.

s0245.literal: On xinyou day the moon transgressed Left Law.
s0245.idiomatic: On xinyou day the moon transgressed Left Law.

s0246.literal: Frost in Longxing Circuit killed crops; 5,723 shi of field rent was remitted.
s0246.idiomatic: Frost in Longxing Circuit killed crops; 5,723 shi of field rent was remitted.

s0247.literal: On renxu day Grand Preceptor Saliman and Hanlin academician exempter Urudai presented the Veritable Records of Taizong.
s0247.idiomatic: On renxu day Grand Preceptor Saliman and Hanlin academician exempter Urudai presented the Veritable Records of Taizong.

s0248.literal: On guihai day the Yellow River broke through at Yitangwan in Xiangfu; Taikang and Tongxu and Chen and Ying prefectures were greatly afflicted.
s0248.idiomatic: On guihai day the Yellow River broke through at Yitangwan in Xiangfu; Taikang and Tongxu and Chen and Ying prefectures were greatly afflicted.

s0249.literal: On jiazi day the Censorate said: "Bandits arose in Jiangnan; officials hunting bandits profited from plunder and also used captives as gifts; we ask that they be returned to their families.
s0249.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Censorate said, "Bandits arose in Jiangnan; officials hunting bandits profited from plunder and also used captives as gifts; we ask that they be returned to their families.

s0250.literal: " The Emperor praised and approved this.
s0250.idiomatic: The Emperor praised and approved this.

s0251.literal: The Hebei-Henan circuit judicial surveillance commission was moved to Xuzhou.
s0251.idiomatic: The Hebei-Henan circuit judicial surveillance commission was moved to Xuzhou.

s0252.literal: The east and west tuqtuqson relay stations in Dadu were abolished and placed under the Bureau of Transmission.
s0252.idiomatic: The east and west tuqtuqson relay stations in Dadu were abolished and placed under the Bureau of Transmission.

s0253.literal: On yichou day the Yi River overflowed; fields and dwellings in Xiong, Mo, Renqiu, and Xin'an were wholly washed away; officials were ordered to build dikes to block it.
s0253.idiomatic: On yichou day the Yi River overflowed; fields and dwellings in Xiong, Mo, Renqiu, and Xin'an were wholly washed away; officials were ordered to build dikes to block it.

s0254.literal: On bingyin day 6,000 horses in Liaoyang were requisitioned; the best were given to Chalih Temur's army.
s0254.idiomatic: On bingyin day 6,000 horses in Liaoyang were requisitioned; the best were given to Chalih Temur's army.

s0255.literal: On dingmao day Xin Cheng tariff market and Pingdi tuqtuqson were established; an envoy was sent to audit Yan'an garrison-farm lands.
s0255.idiomatic: On dingmao day Xin Cheng tariff market and Pingdi tuqtuqson were established; an envoy was sent to audit Yan'an garrison-farm lands.

s0256.literal: Nanxiong Prefecture was reduced to Baochang County and Shaozhou to Qujiang County.
s0256.idiomatic: Nanxiong Prefecture was reduced to Baochang County and Shaozhou to Qujiang County.

s0257.literal: Twelfth month, xinwei day: the Court of the Imperial Stud was changed to the Imperial Pasturage Temple.
s0257.idiomatic: Twelfth month, xinwei day: the Court of the Imperial Stud was changed to the Imperial Pasturage Temple.

s0258.literal: On wuyin day overdue rent from Dadu, Pingluan, Baoding, and Hejian from the twenty-fourth to twenty-sixth year of Zhiyuan—130,562 shi—was remitted.
s0258.idiomatic: On wuyin day overdue rent from Dadu, Pingluan, Baoding, and Hejian from the twenty-fourth to twenty-sixth year of Zhiyuan—130,562 shi—was remitted.

s0259.idiomatic: On jimao day the Bureau of Military Affairs was ordered to requisition civilian weapons in Jiangnan and have officers and soldiers drill in martial arts, as in the edict of the wuzi year.

s0260.literal: On jiashen day Vice Minister of War Jin Rong and others were dispatched to verify military households in Anxi, Fengxiang, and Yan'an circuits; beyond 4,000 on the original register, 33,280 adult males were found; the Bureau of Military Affairs wished to enlist them, Sangge objected, and the Emperor followed this.
s0260.idiomatic: On jiashen day Vice Minister of War Jin Rong and others were dispatched to verify military households in Anxi, Fengxiang, and Yan'an circuits; beyond 4,000 on the original register, 33,280 adult males were found; the Bureau of Military Affairs wished to enlist them, Sangge objected, and the Emperor followed this.

s0261.literal: On bingxu day bandit Zhu Sanshiwu of Xianyou, Xinghua Circuit, gathered a mob and raided Qingshan; chiliarch Li Gang suppressed them.
s0261.idiomatic: On bingxu day bandit Zhu Sanshiwu of Xianyou, Xinghua Circuit, gathered a mob and raided Qingshan; chiliarch Li Gang suppressed them.

s0262.literal: Jingzhao Province submitted 609 ingots from garrison-farm sheep sales; an edict granted them to the poor among Jasan and Ambak's people.
s0262.idiomatic: Jingzhao Province submitted 609 ingots from garrison-farm sheep sales; an edict granted them to the poor among Jasan and Ambak's people.

s0263.literal: On xinmao day the moon transgressed Kang.
s0263.idiomatic: On xinmao day the moon transgressed Kang.

s0264.literal: On yiwei day: initially Wan Yi was divided into four treasuries with gold and silver sent to the inner palace; now the Funing Treasury intendant office was established, rank 5b, to manage it.
s0264.idiomatic: On yiwei day: initially Wan Yi was divided into four treasuries with gold and silver sent to the inner palace; now the Funing Treasury intendant office was established at rank 5b to manage it.

s0265.literal: Many people in Datong Circuit had fled; 21,508 shi of field rent was remitted.
s0265.idiomatic: Many people in Datong Circuit had fled; 21,508 shi of field rent was remitted.

s0266.literal: Famine at Hongzan and Luanyang relay stations; sixty days' grain was issued.
s0266.idiomatic: Famine at Hongzan and Luanyang relay stations; 60 days' grain was issued.

s0267.literal: Famine among the Mekhri under Burdachi; ninety days' grain was issued.
s0267.idiomatic: Famine among the Mekhri under Burdachi; 90 days' grain was issued.

s0268.literal: An edict ordered Prince Naimantai, Liaoyang branch secretariat pingzhang Xuechagan, and right cheng Hongchahu to select 10,000 Mongol troops to garrison in divisions at Shuangcheng and various cities of Posafu to guard against Qaidu's forces.
s0268.idiomatic: An edict ordered Prince Naimantai, Liaoyang branch secretariat pingzhang Xuechagan, and right cheng Hongchahu to select 10,000 Mongol troops to garrison in divisions at Shuangcheng and various cities of Posafu to guard against Qaidu's forces.

s0269.literal: On jihai day Liyang Circuit was reduced to a county and placed under Jiankang.
s0269.idiomatic: On jihai day Liyang Circuit was reduced to a county and placed under Jiankang.

s0270.literal: Huguang Province reported 90,515 liang of tribute pearls over two years.
s0270.idiomatic: Huguang Province reported 90,515 liang of tribute pearls over two years.

s0271.literal: Bandits Liu Jiayi and others of Qingtian, Chuzhou, gathered more than 10,000 men and raided Wenzhou and Pingyang.
s0271.idiomatic: Bandits Liu Jiayi and others of Qingtian, Chuzhou, gathered more than 10,000 men and raided Wenzhou and Pingyang.

s0272.literal: This year gold, silver, notes, and silk were granted to princes, princesses, and consorts as in the annual precedent.
s0272.idiomatic: This year gold, silver, notes, and silk were granted to princes, princesses, and consorts as in the annual precedent.

s0273.literal: The Imperial Preceptor and Buddhist monks were ordered in rotation to perform Buddhist rites and meditation at Wanshou Shan Houzaimen, Chaghan Na'er, Shenghou Wan'an Temple, Huanzhou Nanping Hermitage, Shuangquan, and other sites—seventy-two sessions in all.
s0273.idiomatic: The Imperial Preceptor and Buddhist monks were ordered in rotation to perform Buddhist rites and meditation at Wanshou Shan Houzaimen, Chaghan Na'er, Shenghou Wan'an Temple, Huanzhou Nanping Hermitage, Shuangquan, and other sites—72 sessions in all.

s0274.literal: Seventy-two persons were sentenced to death.

s0275.literal: Twenty-eighth year, spring, first month, renyin day: Venus, Mars, and Saturn gathered at Kui.
s0275.idiomatic: Twenty-eighth year, spring, first month, renyin day: Venus, Mars, and Saturn gathered at Kui.

s0276.literal: On guimao day a seal was granted to Prince Aiyachi.
s0276.idiomatic: On guimao day a seal was granted to Prince Aiyachi.

s0277.literal: Taoist patriarch Zhang Liusun was ordered to perform three days of altar rites and star worship.
s0277.idiomatic: Taoist patriarch Zhang Liusun was ordered to perform three days of altar rites and star worship.

s0278.literal: Many people at Shangdu relied on government grain; an edict hired civilians to transport 100,000 shi of rice to Shangdu at forty liang per shi, with garrison commander Mubalasha overseeing it.
s0278.idiomatic: Many people at Shangdu relied on government grain; an edict hired civilians to transport 100,000 shi of rice to Shangdu at 40 liang per shi, with garrison commander Mubalasha overseeing it.

s0279.literal: On xinhai day relay households from twelve stations from Bianliang to Zhengyang, Qixian, Suizhou, Zhongmou, Zheng, Tang, and Deng were released to civilian status.
s0279.idiomatic: On xinhai day relay households from 12 stations from Bianliang to Zhengyang, Qixian, Suizhou, Zhongmou, Zheng, Tang, and Deng were released to civilian status.

s0280.literal: On guichou day Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
s0280.idiomatic: On guichou day Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

s0281.literal: On dingsi day 400 guiyou chi were dispatched on a northern campaign.
s0281.idiomatic: On dingsi day 400 guiyou chi were dispatched on a northern campaign.

s0282.literal: On xinyou day the Jiang-Huai grain transport bureau was abolished and merged into the sea-ship ten-thousand-household office; grain transport went by sea route.
s0282.idiomatic: On xinyou day the Jiang-Huai grain transport bureau was abolished and merged into the sea-ship ten-thousand-household office; grain transport went by sea route.

s0283.literal: The Zhexi gold and jade artisans intendant office was merged into the Zhexi gold and jade artisans commissionerate.
s0283.idiomatic: The Zhexi gold and jade artisans intendant office was merged into the Zhexi gold and jade artisans commissionerate.

s0284.literal: Wuwei and Hezhou two circuits and Lu'an Army were reduced to prefectures; Chaozhou was reduced to a county and placed under Wuwei; all were subordinate to Luzhou Circuit.
s0284.idiomatic: Wuwei and Hezhou two circuits and Lu'an Army were reduced to prefectures; Chaozhou was reduced to a county and placed under Wuwei; all were subordinate to Luzhou Circuit.

s0285.literal: Anfeng Prefecture was promoted to a circuit; Shouchun Prefecture and Huaiyuan Army were reduced to counties; Huaiyuan was placed under Haozhou; all were subordinate to Anfeng Circuit.
s0285.idiomatic: Anfeng Prefecture was promoted to a circuit; Shouchun Prefecture and Huaiyuan Army were reduced to counties; Huaiyuan was placed under Haozhou; all were subordinate to Anfeng Circuit.

s0286.literal: Branch secretariat judicial inquiry offices everywhere were promoted to rank 4.
s0286.idiomatic: Branch secretariat judicial inquiry offices everywhere were promoted to rank 4.

s0287.literal: Overdue field rent of poor people in Jiang-Huai from Zhiyuan years twelve to twenty-five—more than 2,976,000 shi—was remitted, as well as unpaid 130,000 shi of field rent, 1,150 ingots of notes, 5,400 jin of silk, and more than 1,430 jin of cotton from year twenty-six.
s0287.idiomatic: Overdue field rent of poor people in Jiang-Huai from Zhiyuan years 12 to 25—more than 2,976,000 shi—was remitted, as well as unpaid 130,000 shi of field rent, 1,150 ingots of notes, 5,400 jin of silk, and more than 1,430 jin of cotton from year 26.

s0288.literal: The gold-panning intendant office was abolished and the Jiangdong-Liang-Zhe transport commissionerate was established.
s0288.idiomatic: The gold-panning intendant office was abolished and the Jiangdong-Liang-Zhe transport commissionerate was established.

s0289.literal: On renxu day Jasan and Tutugh commanded troops at Ugu; officials were ordered to supply their needs; Datong Circuit was commanded to issue grain to relieve famine victims in Ugu.
s0289.idiomatic: On renxu day Jasan and Tutugh commanded troops at Ugu; officials were ordered to supply their needs; Datong Circuit was commanded to issue grain to relieve famine victims in Ugu.

s0290.literal: Ministry secretariat officials Sangge and others were dismissed for crimes.
s0290.idiomatic: Ministry secretariat officials Sangge and others were dismissed for crimes.

s0291.literal: Second month, xinwei day: 10,000 gelded horses were granted to the troops under Yesudai'er.
s0291.idiomatic: Second month, xinwei day: 10,000 gelded horses were granted to the troops under Yesudai'er.

s0292.literal: Gold and silver from the Wan Yi treasury were moved into the inner Funing treasury.
s0292.idiomatic: Gold and silver from the Wan Yi treasury were moved into the inner Funing treasury.

s0293.literal: The Ministry Secretariat said: "In Datong 70,000 people rely on government grain, using 800,000 shi annually; an envoy was sent to re-verify; 13,500 who should not receive it are identified; we ask to reclaim it for the state.
s0293.idiomatic: The Ministry Secretariat said, "In Datong 70,000 people rely on government grain, using 800,000 shi annually; an envoy was sent to re-verify; 13,500 who should not receive it are identified; we ask to reclaim it for the state.

s0295.literal: On guiyou day Longxi-Sichuan general supervisor Nianzhenshunai was made overall president of Buddhist monasteries on all circuits.
s0295.idiomatic: On guiyou day Longxi-Sichuan general supervisor Nianzhenshunai was made overall president of Buddhist monasteries on all circuits.

s0296.literal: Fujian branch secretariat was changed to a pacification commission subordinate to Jiangxi branch secretariat.
s0296.idiomatic: Fujian branch secretariat was changed to a pacification commission subordinate to Jiangxi branch secretariat.

s0297.literal: An edict ordered: "Branch censorates are not to obey branch secretariat direction.
s0297.idiomatic: An edict ordered, "Branch censorates are not to obey branch secretariat direction.

s0298.literal: " Yunnan branch secretariat officials said: "The Shuizhou-Wumeng water route is dangerous; many boats are wrecked; it would be better to go by land from Yeshao water station via Zhongqing, then through Yanjing, Tulao, Bisa, and other barbarian territories to Qingfu in Xuzhou; this can be made a relay route with five stations in all.
s0298.idiomatic: Yunnan branch secretariat officials said, "The Shuizhou-Wumeng water route is dangerous; many boats are wrecked; it would be better to go by land from Yeshao water station via Zhongqing, then through Yanjing, Tulao, Bisa, and other barbarian territories to Qingfu in Xuzhou; this can be made a relay route with five stations in all.

s0300.literal: Yesudai'er and Commander Wang said: "By recent regulation, corvée purchase and forced purchase did not apply to military households; now they are treated the same as commoners.
s0300.idiomatic: Yesudai'er and Commander Wang said, "By recent regulation, corvée purchase and forced purchase did not apply to military households; now they are treated the same as commoners.
